name: circular_flange_six_bolt_holes
description: A circular flange plate with six evenly spaced circular bolt holes.
source_license: Project-authored example; not from an external dataset.
derived_by: Hand-authored from validated Prompt2ParametricCAD eval JSON.
construction_plan: Create a circular base extrusion on the XY plane.
Use one circular cut operation with six positions arranged around the origin.
Keep the bolt-circle radius smaller than the base radius.
Use depth "through" because bolt holes pass through the flange.
notes: Circular patterns can be represented directly by listing the repeated positions.
For a six-hole pattern, use points every 60 degrees around the center.
